translations./title: After a write fails, create the file and try again
translations./summary: The user asks for a new `WebDevProjects` folder containing three files, each with specified text. The file tools separate creation (`touch`) from writing (`echo`).
translations./presentation/steps/0/title: Writing directly fails because the file does not exist
translations./presentation/steps/1/title: Create the file, then retry the write with the same arguments
translations./presentation/steps/2/title: A later read confirms that the content was written
translations./presentation/steps/2/summary: The agent also uses `touch` before `echo` for the other two files. When the user later asks to read the first file in the system’s listing order, it reads `styles.css`.
